column3: the loosened-haired women whose lords were killed
... of the Self-possessed, whose attachments are all released
out of desire for Hari's lotus feet
in river waters sanctified by the dust of Hari's lotus feet
the Lord, his mind attracted by Hari's qualities
O wise one, stories of Hari's incarnations
climbed to the mansions, the brahmanas
of elephants, horses, chariots and foot soldiers
in the palm of the hand
in the conquest of the quarters by Hiranyaksha
eighteenth chapter on the slaying of Hiranyaksha
in the region of the heart
in the middle of the heart
dweller in the cave of the heart
does not move away from the heart
like the lord of the senses
cause of creation, preservation and dissolution
by the splendour of the weapon
and the meaning of the Veda
removing the distress of the afflicted
with a blanket and kusha grass
ritual placing of mantras on the hand
grace; food offered to the Lord
those who sleep on bare ground
